items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 26 at 6:38AM PDT until September 27 at 5:00AM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 4 to 7 ft at 8 seconds and north winds 10 to 25 kt
expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Cape Shoalwater WA to Cape Falcon
OR out 10 NM and Waters from Cape Shoalwater WA to Cape Falcon
OR from 10 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...From 5 PM this afternoon to 5 AM PDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
